name: Family and newborn photography
summary: How expats book family, newborn, and milestone photography in Singapore — studio vs outdoor heat logistics, usage rights, and trial cues before prepaid annual packages.
body:
Family photography here splits between studio control (air-con, lighting) and outdoor sessions at gardens or heritage backdrops. Newborn lifestyle or posed studio work has different safety and timing norms than holiday mini-sessions.

## Common bookings
- Newborn sessions (often within early weeks)
- Family annuals for grandparents abroad
- Work-pass / PR celebration portraits
- School application or passport-adjacent formal sets (separate from ICA vendors)
- Cake smash / milestone minis

Confirm whether edited digital files, prints, or only social-media sneaks are included.

## Heat and babies
Outdoor midday shoots melt toddlers — book early morning or studio. Newborn photographers should explain handling, temperature, and whether posing props are optional. Never force lengthy posed setups on an unwell infant.

## How to choose
Review full galleries, not only highlight reels. Prefer written contracts covering usage rights (your Instagram vs their ads). Ask about sibling kink-management and reschedule policies for fever. Avoid huge prepaid “year of shoots” until you like one session’s edit style.

## Practical tip
Align outfits to a simple palette and bring snacks/quiet toys. Share a shot list of must-have family combinations before the session starts.
